  "multiple_comparison_strategy": "Apply the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure to control the False Discovery Rate (FDR) across the set of all pairwise comparisons (10 comparisons per metric * 5 metrics = 50 tests) to reduce the likelihood of Type I errors while maintaining statistical power.",

    "Homogeneity of variances: Conduct Levene's test for all continuous metrics.",
    "Linearity: Ensure linear relationships between predictors and the log-odds of the response in the logistic model.",
    "Multicollinearity: Check Variance Inflation Factors (VIF) if including multiple performance variables in a single model."
  ],
  "expected_findings": [
    "Significant main effects are expected for all five metrics given the distinct means in the summary data.",
    "The 'Sham' group is expected to show significantly lower Success rates and higher Time-to-Target compared to all other groups.",
    "The 'Combined' group is expected to show the highest Path Efficiency and Average Speed, suggesting a synergistic effect of stimulation.",
    "AD (Angular Dispersion) is expected to be significantly higher in 'Combined' and 'ICMS Only' groups compared to 'Sham', indicating less precise navigation or different exploration strategies.",
    "Dim Visual Only and Bright Visual Only are expected to perform similarly to each other but worse than Combined/ICMS and better than Sham."
  ],

    "The analysis relies on summary statistics; individual mouse variability and potential confounding factors (e.g., specific Mouse ID effects) cannot be fully disentangled without access to the raw trial-level data.",

    "Skewness in 'Time-to-Target' (min 0.5, max 201.4) may violate normality assumptions, requiring non-parametric alternatives or transformations.",
    "The predictive model recommendation assumes the relationship between performance and paradigm is consistent across the dataset, which may not hold if there are hidden subgroups."
  ],
